title: Verify Service Advisor is blocked from voiding a transaction while Manage AP/AR is OFF
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Advisor role. (Invoicing Delete additionally requires Manage AP/AR ON per spec v33 / SV-7913; this role has Manage AP/AR OFF).
Note: the role may display as 'Junior Service Advisor' in the build (the spec calls it 'Service Advisor').
The work order already has an invoice created on its Finance tab.
steps:
1. Open the work order's Finance tab and locate a transaction.
2. Try to void the transaction.
expected: Voiding is BLOCKED (configuration prompt or permission block) because Manage AP/AR is OFF. Intended behavior per SV-7913.
